snapshot.title: Add PostHog micro-surveys for uncovered game mechanics
snapshot.description: Four in-game micro-surveys (1-2 questions each) were identified and created to cover mechanics not addressed by the existing exit survey: contractor signing, mining feel, real science awareness, and mission progression clarity.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Contractor survey triggers after first contractor is signed
Mining survey triggers after first mining run completes
Science awareness survey triggers after first scanner scan
Progression clarity survey triggers after mission 2, 3, 4 debrief (once per stage)
No survey overlaps with exit survey or other micro-surveys
